description: This Java source file defines the ResourceNotAccessibleException class, a specialized exception indicating that a resource was either missing or access was denied due to insufficient permissions. It is part of the policies exceptions package within the Eclipse Ditto framework, providing mechanisms for creating, parsing, and managing this specific exception type used in policy-related error handling.
